title: House Robber
statement: You are a professional thief planning to rob houses along a street. Each house has a certain amount of money stashed. You cannot rob two adjacent houses because an alarm system will trigger. Given an integer array nums where nums[i] represents the amount of money in the i-th house, return the maximum amount of money you can rob without alerting the police.

visibleExamples.explanation: Rob house 1 (money = 2), house 3 (money = 9) and house 5 (money = 1). Total = 2 + 9 + 1 = 12.
Only one house, rob it for 5.
